attchmntText: Surya Roshni Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Surya Roshni Limited filed the transcript of its earnings call for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The company reported consolidated revenue of INR2,448 crores for Q2FY27, a 33% year-on-year increase. EBITDA stood at INR143 crores and PAT at INR77 crores. For H1FY27, revenue grew 30% to INR4,495 crores. The Steel Pipes and Strips segment recorded record volumes of 2.67 lakh tons in Q2. The Lighting and Consumer Durables segment achieved revenue of INR507 crores. The company remains debt-free with a cash surplus of INR75 crores. Management indicated plans for a share buyback, subject to Board approval. The order book stands at over INR1,400 crores across both businesses.

attchmntText: Surya Roshni Limited has informed the Exchange about Certificate under Regulation 74(5) of SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018
desc: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018
voiceSummary: Surya Roshni Limited filed a certificate with the National Stock Exchange and Bombay Stock Exchange pursuant to Regulation 74(5) of the SEBI Depositories and Participants Regulations 2018 for the month ended October 2026. The company confirmed that share certificates for dematerialized shares were mutilated and cancelled after verification. Depository names were substituted in records within the stipulated period. Mas Services Limited, the company registrar, reported that 224 shares were dematerialized via CDSL during October 2026. No shares were rematerialized. Zero shares were dematerialized via NSDL. The report lists specific dematerialization details including dates, client IDs, and share quantities for two transactions. The total shares dematerialized amount to 224. This filing serves as information and record for the exchanges.

attchmntText: Surya Roshni Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Surya Roshni Limited filed a notice regarding the publication of a newspaper advertisement on 8th November 2026. The advertisement discloses the extract of Unaudited Consolidated and Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. These results were approved by the Board of Directors at its meeting held on 7th November 2026. The advertisement was published in Economic Times English Edition in New Delhi and Mumbai, Dainik Tribune Hindi Edition in Chandigarh, and Economic Times English in all editions. The information is also available on the company website at www.surya.co.in.

attchmntText: Surya Roshni Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Surya Roshni Limited has made the audio recording of the earnings call for the quarter ended 30th September 2026 available on its website. The call was scheduled for 7th November 2026 at 3:30 P.M. IST to discuss the Unaudited financial results and operational performance. The audio file can be accessed via the link provided in the submission to BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India. The intimation was filed by the Company Secretary, B. B. Singal, in compliance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Surya Roshni Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Surya Roshni Limited filed its Investor Presentation for November 2026 with the National Stock Exchange and Mumbai Stock Exchange. The presentation details Q2 and H1 FY27 results. Consolidated revenue for Q2 FY27 grew 33% year-on-year to Rs. 2,448 crore. EBITDA stood at Rs. 143 crore and Profit After Tax at Rs. 77 crore. For H1 FY27, consolidated revenue grew 30% year-on-year to Rs. 4,495 crore. The Lighting and Consumer Durables segment reported revenue of Rs. 507 crore in Q2 FY27. The Steel Pipes and Strips segment achieved a record quarterly sales volume of 2.67 lakh tonnes. The company maintains a net cash surplus of Rs. 75 crore as of September 30, 2026.

attchmntText: Surya Roshni Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 07, 2026, titled "SURYA ROSHNI LIMITED ANNOUNCES Q2 & H1 FY27 RESULTS".
voiceSummary: Surya Roshni Limited announced unaudited financial results for Q2 and H1 FY27 ended September 30, 2026. The Board approved the results on November 7, 2026. Consolidated revenue for Q2 FY27 grew 33% year-on-year to Rs. 2,448 crore. EBITDA was Rs. 143 crore and Profit After Tax was Rs. 77 crore. For H1 FY27, consolidated revenue grew 30% year-on-year to Rs. 4,495 crore. EBITDA grew 18% to Rs. 263 crore. Profit After Tax grew 26% to Rs. 136 crore. The Steel Pipes and Strips segment recorded revenue of Rs. 1,941 crore. Lighting and Consumer Durables segment revenue was Rs. 507 crore. The total order book stands at approximately Rs. 1,400 crore.

attchmntText: Surya Roshni Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Surya Roshni Limited reported unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026, approved by the Board on 7th November 2026. Standalone revenue from operations for the quarter was Rs. 2,44,835 lakhs, with a profit after tax of Rs. 7,664 lakhs. Earnings per share stood at Rs. 3.52. For the half year, revenue was Rs. 4,49,465 lakhs, and profit after tax was Rs. 13,612 lakhs, with EPS at Rs. 6.25. The statutory auditors, M/s Ashok Kumar Goyal & Co., issued an unmodified limited review report. The company holds no treasury shares as the Employees Welfares Trust has disposed of all its holdings.
